archetypes.name: file-conflict-parity
archetypes.rationale: The Python port must match the retired Bash parser, path extraction, interval overlap, and cap behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review python/file_oos.py against the retired helper contract as represented by the new tests. Focus on parse_issue_input ordinal handling, malformed-item skips, clean_match normalization, comma and semicolon splitting, path safety, inclusive ranges, one-edge-per-pair behavior, component chain degradation, global-cap failure, and atomic output cleanup. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: oos-filer-degrade
archetypes.rationale: Step 9a.1 now shells through the CLI and has nuanced exit-code cleanup semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect python/oos_filer.py and python/test_oos_filer.py for the three pre-pass outcomes. Verify non-empty success forwards deps, empty success stays silent with deps_path=None, exit 1 warns and unlinks stale TSV, and exit 2 warns without unlinking a pre-existing TSV. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: retired-surface-cleanup
archetypes.rationale: Deleting the Bash helper requires complete doc, lint, and migration metadata cleanup.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the migration cleanup surfaces for stale references to the deleted helper and harness paths outside allowed larch-log and migrated-scripts manifest areas. Check docs/linting.md, SKILL.md machine reachability, execution-issues tracking prose, agent-lint excludes, residual-bash manifest, and migrated-scripts rows. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
